summary.text: Kent Marmon is a Republican who represents District 11 (Seat A) in the Idaho House of Representatives and is listed in a first term; the directory lists Marmon as retired.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's biography, Marmon is a native Idahoan, graduated from Caldwell High School and earned a B.S. in business administration from Northwest Nazarene University.
It says Marmon owned and operated a family printing business for 12 years, served on the Caldwell City Council in the mid-1980s, and served as a Caldwell School Board member.
